items.label: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.detail: Figma Weave brings AI generation and editing tools together into connected, reusable workflows, giving you a process your team can shape, refine, and repeat. Here’s what it unlocks for creative teams…

items.label: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
items.detail: We’ve increasingly seen that specialized post-training can compete with frontier models. Here, we’re sharing the research behind how we’re translating that to design editing workflows.

items.label: Making something human: 4 things we took away from Config India
items.detail: AI can help us create almost anything now. But from icons and NFTs to art installations and fashion design, it's still up to the maker to deliver something that resonates.

items.label: How to put your design system to work with the Figma agent
items.detail: Your design system can help the Figma agent understand the principles and guidelines that define your product. Here’s how to make that context useful to the agent.

items.label: How Lufthansa Systems prototypes realistic maps for the cockpit with Figma Make
